1.outline: Term theme: 'Capstone — Site, Portfolio & AI'. Plan a portfolio website showcasing the whole primary journey, ready for secondary school.
1.sowResources: Printed planning sheet, example portfolio site.
objectives: Plan a portfolio site covering multiple years of work.
Decide the pages needed.
Sketch a clear sitemap.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Look at an example
plan.detail: Explore an example portfolio site and discuss what makes it effective.

plan.title: Plan the sitemap
plan.detail: Sketch pages: Home, About, best work, and a 'ready for secondary' reflection page.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Pitch the plan to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: My sitemap covers Home, About and best work.
My plan includes a reflection page.
I can pitch my plan to a partner.

2.outline: Build the Home and About pages: a welcoming introduction and some information about the pupil as a learner.
objectives: Build a Home page with a clear introduction.
Build an About page describing myself as a learner.
Apply consistent design across both.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build Home and About
plan.detail: Write and format the Home introduction and the About page.

plan.title: Consistency check
plan.detail: Check both pages use the same theme and layout style. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My Home page has a clear introduction.
My About page describes me as a learner.
Both pages use a consistent design.

3.outline: Add a page showcasing the year's best work: a document, a spreadsheet, a video and a coding project, linked or embedded.
3.sowResources: Google Sites, links/exports of past work.
objectives: Choose the best piece of work in each category.
Link or embed each piece on a showcase page.
Write a short caption for each.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Choose the best
plan.detail: Look back through the year's work and choose one document, one spreadsheet, one video and one coding project.

plan.title: Add and caption
plan.detail: Link or embed each piece on the showcase page with a short caption.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: I chose one piece of work in each category.
Each piece is linked or embedded correctly.
Each piece has a short caption.

4.outline: Under teacher guidance, build a small game or tool using an AI tool and add it to its own page on the site.
objectives: Use a guided AI tool to build a small game or tool.
Test that it works.
Add it to a new page with a description.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build with AI
plan.detail: Under supervision, use the guided AI tool to build a small game or tool.

plan.title: Add the page
plan.detail: Create a new page, embed the tool, and write a short description.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

activities: Create and describe the AI page
successCriteria: I built a working tool or game with the guided AI tool.
It is embedded on its own page.
The page has a short description.

5.outline: Recap digital citizenship lessons from across the year — online safety, kindness, privacy and passwords — through discussion.
objectives: Recall key digital citizenship rules from the year.
Discuss a real-life scenario applying these rules.
Write one citizenship tip for a younger pupil.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Recap the year
plan.detail: Recap key rules: privacy, kindness, passwords, checking information.

plan.title: Scenario discussion
plan.detail: Discuss a real-life scenario and apply the rules to decide what to do.

plan.title: Write a tip
plan.detail: Write one citizenship tip for a younger pupil. Log out.

activities: Write a tip for a younger pupil
successCriteria: I recalled key digital citizenship rules from the year.
I applied the rules to a real-life scenario.
I wrote a useful tip for a younger pupil.

6.outline: Test every link on the site works, and check every page for personal information that shouldn't be public.
objectives: Test every link on the site.
Check every page for inappropriate personal information.
Fix any issues found.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Navigation test
plan.detail: Click every link on every page and note anything broken.

plan.title: Privacy sweep
plan.detail: Check every page for full names, addresses or personal photos that shouldn't be public.

plan.title: Fix it
plan.detail: Fix any issues found. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I tested every link on my site.
I checked every page for privacy issues.
I fixed any issues found.

7.outline: Publish the finished portfolio site with the correct sharing settings.
objectives: Publish the finished site.
Set the correct sharing/visibility settings.
Confirm the published link works.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Publish
plan.detail: Publish the site with correct sharing settings.

plan.title: Confirm it works
plan.detail: Open the published link in a new tab and click through it.

plan.title: Save the link
plan.detail: Save the published link. Log out.

successCriteria: My site is published with correct settings.
I confirmed the published link works.
I saved the published link.

8.outline: Present the finished portfolio site to the class, reflecting on readiness for secondary school ICT.
objectives: Present the finished portfolio site.
Reflect on readiness for secondary school ICT.
Save the site link to the portfolio.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Present
plan.detail: Present the portfolio site to the class.

plan.title: Ready-for-secondary reflection
plan.detail: Discuss: what skills am I taking into secondary ICT?

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the site link to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished portfolio site.
I reflected on my readiness for secondary ICT.
My site link is saved to the portfolio folder.

9.outline: Add a page summarising the ICT skills learned across all three years of upper primary.
objectives: List the ICT skills learned across the years.
Build a summary page for the site.
Re-publish the site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the summary
plan.detail: List and briefly describe the ICT skills learned since Year 4.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Add the page and re-publish the site.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: My summary page lists key ICT skills.
My summary page is added to the site.
My re-published site works correctly.

10.outline: Rehearse the term's site-building skills in pairs: build a page, embed work, check privacy, publish.
10.sowResources: Recap slide deck, practice task cards.
objectives: Recall the term's site-building process in order.
Rehearse building and publishing a page with a partner.
Identify the trickiest step.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Process recap
plan.detail: Recap: plan, pages, best work, AI, privacy, publish — as a class chant.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Build and publish a short page with a partner reading the task card, then swap.

plan.title: Tricky step check
plan.detail: Name the step you still find hardest. Log out.

successCriteria: I can list the term's site-building steps in order.
I rehearsed building and publishing with a partner.
I know which step needs more practice.

11.outline: Individual task: build and publish a portfolio site showcasing the year's work, including an AI-made tool.
objectives: Build a portfolio site showcasing best work.
Include an AI-made tool.
Publish with correct privacy settings.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Build the portfolio
plan.detail: Individual practical: build pages showcasing work and the AI tool.

plan.title: Privacy check and publish
plan.detail: Check for personal information, then publish.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My portfolio site showcases my best work.
My site includes an AI-made tool.
My site is published with correct privacy settings.

12.outline: Plan a final showcase page: 'My ICT Journey', reflecting on growth from Year 1 to Year 6.
objectives: Reflect on ICT skills learned since Year 1.
Plan a 'My ICT Journey' page.
Choose evidence to include.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Reflect and plan
plan.detail: Reflect on growth since Year 1 and plan the journey page with evidence to include.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Tell a partner the plan. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan reflects on growth since Year 1.
My plan lists evidence to include.
I can tell a partner my plan.

13.outline: Build the 'My ICT Journey' page, following the plan.
objectives: Build the journey page.
Include the planned evidence.
Write a short reflection.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the page
plan.detail: Build the journey page with evidence and a short written reflection.

plan.title: Check
plan.detail: Check it matches the original plan. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My journey page includes the planned evidence.
My journey page has a written reflection.
My page matches my original plan.

14.outline: Final privacy check, republish the complete portfolio site, and rehearse presenting the whole thing.
objectives: Do a final privacy check.
Re-publish the complete site.
Rehearse presenting it.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Final privacy check
plan.detail: Check every page one more time.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Re-publish the complete portfolio site.

plan.title: Rehearse
plan.detail: Practise presenting the whole portfolio to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: My portfolio passed a final privacy check.
My complete site is re-published.
I rehearsed presenting it to a partner.

15.outline: Present the finished portfolio site to Year 5 or another class, celebrating the primary ICT journey before moving to secondary.
objectives: Present the finished portfolio confidently to visitors.
Explain my ICT journey and growth.
Save the whole primary portfolio.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through before visitors arrive.

plan.title: Fair with visitors
plan.detail: Present portfolio sites to visiting classmates or a younger year group.

plan.title: Save the portfolio
plan.detail: Save the final site link and all files into the portfolio folder.

plan.title: Farewell reflection
plan.detail: Reflect on the whole primary ICT journey, ready for secondary. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my portfolio confidently to visitors.
I explained my ICT journey and growth.
My whole primary portfolio is saved.
